english.title: Persistently follow person with view to compelling person to do or abstain from doing lawful act

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Trade Union and Labour Relations Consolidation Act 1992

english.legislation: Contrary to section 241(1)(b) and (2) of the Trade Union and Labour Relations (Consolidation) Act 1992
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
with a view to compelling another person to abstain from doing or to do an act
which that person had a legal right to do or abstain from doing
wrongfully and without legal authority
persistently followed that person about from place to place

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
